note: Synthetic tickers only (SPCX, KLMN, ORBT, NOVA, QBIT, ZENT, LUMA, ACME, TRVX, VYRA...). No real logos, no performance claims. lp-01 is a copy of assets/x-promo-2-1007.jpg.
